visual_review.notes: Autonomously reviewed every chronological original in selected takes, enlarged anatomy/grips/alpha edges and all 224 selected phases at native 128px battle reference height. Readable hand-to-lantern idle, reciprocal gait under robes, two-handed butt strike and recovery, held guard, physical open-hand support signal, aimed ranged release/recovery, balanced hit recoil/recovery and grounded side collapse. One staff and one blue-over-amber lantern housing preserved. Attack originals 34-35 are excluded whole for clipping; clean 33-to-36 angles retain the swing with an explicit 70ms sample interval, inspected at native scale. Rejected hard-cut ranged v1, clipped attack/guard v1 and changing-background hit remainder remain source-only. All selected opaque tips lie inside source canvases. Continuous temporal playback, manual game playtest and Linux validation were not performed; chronological frame review and native phase renders are the visual evidence. Candidate 749 focused checks passed.
